text:
By Jael Rucker ,
10 hours ago

Sorel and Barbour have teamed up to launch their very first collection together , and as a nature girl, I, for one, couldn’t be more excited.
A collaboration that merges Sorel’s commitment to performance footwear with Barbour’s heritage style , both brands describe this capsule as the “rugged beauty of utility meeting the quiet sophistication of luxury.” At the forefront are key pieces that will have you well-equipped to take on whatever outdoor adventures fall and winter hold for you.
Want to know which buzzy products are *really* worth buying? Sign up for our shopping newsletter to uncover our favorite finds.
Sorel
That includes three footwear styles: the SOREL x Barbour Callsign Horizon Low GTX ($250), the Daystorm Horizon GTX ($300) and the updated Caribou Horizon GTX ($450), which comes with a reimagined corduroy collar.
Additionally, there’s the SOREL x Barbour Transport Down Wax puffer jacket ($899) made from waxed cotton, which features 80/20 down fill power sure to keep you toasty in chilly temps, along with moleskin hand-warmer pocket bags that will especially come in handy if you forget (or don't like) wearing gloves.
Sorel
While I adore everything in this collection, my absolute favorite piece is the Daystorm Horizon GTX , a stylish workboot packed with technical features that are a dream for the wet, snowy and muddy conditions we'll soon be encountering. For starters, they're made from 100 percent full-grain leather that is both waterproof *and* certified by the Leather Working Group. They also come with Barbour’s signature Tartan textile tongue and have a lace closure that keeps your feet comfortable and secure as you trudge through even the slushiest conditions. How about the traction, you ask? The lug outsole is made with molded XS TREK Vibram, specifically engineered to provide good grip in wet conditions, while, inside, you'll find a removable Ortholite footbed that promises plenty of cushioning and impact absorption.
Needless to say, this collab is a must for all of my fellow nature lovers (who can appreciate the aesthetic of good design) planning to spend time outdoors this season and beyond. And if you're looking for the perfect gift for the hiker or camper on your list, you can't go wrong.
